what_happened: A docs job to fix the firstmate study's "Reopened" state (make it non-terminal, with a return to Queued) was rejected at final verification. The producer added a new transition t12 in model.json and edited the reopened glossary text in intro.json. Two of four acceptance criteria were unmet. (1) The Queued return is a new claim, but it cites only c23-c25, which do not support it, and claims.json was not updated. (2) The criterion that required cited commands as evidence was unmet (D43), and the cargo test / clippy criterion was unmet because tests failed. Findings: a blocker, because t12 sets a guard of "none" yet says code evaluates it, which a study rule test forbids. Two majors: the uncited Queued claim and the missing command evidence. A fourth major: the format check fails on changed test code at xtask/src/site.rs:963. Two checks failed (these are checks, not criteria): fmt and test. The producer's own edits therefore broke a study rule test and formatting, and it did not add the claim the new transition needs.
cause: Study files are governed by structural rules (guard fields, cited claims, claims.json entries) that are enforced only by the test suite and the final verifier. The reading and the producer are not told that a new transition needs a matching cited claim and a legal guard value, and nothing runs the study validation tests, fmt, or a claim-to-citation cross-check after each edit. The criterion "no new uncited claims" also conflicts with the request itself, which adds a new fact (the Queued return) that no existing claim supports. Nothing makes the reading require the claim to be added first. So the producer finishes, and the gaps surface only at the end, after all spend.
prevention: Run the study validation tests and fmt as a gate inside the producer's run, before handover. Add a code check that every transition and glossary statement in a study cites claims present in claims.json, and that guard "none" has no evaluator. At reading time, when a request adds a fact not covered by existing claims, require the reading to list the new claim and the claims.json edit as a deliverable, and to drop any criterion that forbids it.
proposed_request: Fix the firstmate study (studies/firstmate-work-handling) so the Reopened state is not terminal and returns to Queued. Deliverables: (1) add a claim in claims.json, with its source, that states the Reopened to Queued return; (2) add transition t12 in model.json from Reopened to Queued citing that claim, with guard "none" and no guard_evaluated_by value, as the study rules require; (3) update the reopened glossary entry and the states lead-in in intro.json so they cite that claim plus c23-c25 and no uncited statement remains; (4) run cargo fmt so xtask/src/site.rs is formatted. Acceptance: cargo fmt --check, cargo test and cargo clippy pass; the study validation tests pass; every new or changed statement in intro.json and model.json cites a claim in claims.json; the source check on the study page passes for the reopened state. The producer's report must list the commands it ran, with their results.
